original_test_intent: Verify that the approved RAID adapter can be physically installed in the supported slot, the system enters BIOS normally, and BIOS displays the correct controller and attached HDD/SSD information.
original_method: A qualified operator performs the vendor power/ESD installation, powers on, enters BIOS through local/KVM console and captures all expected controller and drive fields; read-only OS/controller inventory may corroborate the final state.
manual_activity: User approves the adapter/slot and recovery plan; qualified operator installs the card, enters BIOS and captures the complete display; agent may collect read-only corroboration only.
required_inputs: Supported platform, PCIe slot, RAID adapter model/serial/firmware and power requirements
Attached HDD/SSD serial/slot/topology and expected BIOS fields
Vendor power-down, ESD, installation and power-on procedure
Qualified operator, KVM/local console, OOB and protected photo storage
safety_requirements: Power and service the chassis only under the approved vendor procedure
Verify adapter/slot/firmware compatibility and attached-storage dependencies before insertion
Preserve pre-existing logs and all pre-install boot/RAID state
Stop on wrong hardware, seating resistance, power/thermal fault, missing or unexpected drives, BIOS/boot/RAID error or management loss
Do not change BIOS/RAID configuration, rebuild, repartition or repeatedly reboot as part of this information-only case
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre/post read-only platform, RAID, drive, boot, health and BMC evidence when available
Compare operator-captured BIOS fields with the approved adapter/drive matrix
Flag discrepancies without changing controller or BIOS state
Do not install hardware, navigate/interpret unseen BIOS screens or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve adapter/slot/topology, installation and recovery procedure
Provide qualified operator/KVM and define authoritative BIOS fields
Review physical, BIOS and supplemental OS evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: storcli and lsblk can corroborate a post-boot inventory, but insecure SSH and head-truncated output cannot prove physical installation, successful BIOS entry or the BIOS controller/drive display.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Primary execution is the documented manual installation and BIOS capture; if the system boots, collect secure untruncated vendor RAID CLI, lsblk, health and complete OS/BMC logs without changing state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Adapter insertion, power-on, BIOS controller/drive information check and source 5/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture an identity-locked installation record and complete BIOS screenshots, then cross-check rather than replace them with read-only controller/OS inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit safety, recovery and evidence traceability while retaining the physical/BIOS nature of the test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Supplemental automation adds corroboration only; it cannot reduce or replace manual coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BIOS labels and controller option-ROM presentation are platform-specific; only the approved expected-field matrix governs comparison.

project_override_considerations: If the adapter is embedded rather than removable, engineering must provide a variant-specific service/identity method; this row's literal physical insertion must not be silently rewritten.
expected_evidence: Operator identity, ESD/power procedure and installation photos
Complete BIOS entry plus controller, firmware, drive and array-display captures
Optional untruncated RAID CLI, lsblk, health and boot/mount inventory
Complete dmesg/syslog/SEL/BMC and final approved state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requires physical installation and BIOS inspection. DeepSeek's OS-only substitution is incomplete coverage, not an ambiguity in the original source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Adapter, operator, BIOS access and recovery are normal manual prerequisites; the review and purpose are clear.

review_improvement: Reinstates the authoritative physical installation and BIOS display evidence and demotes OS inventory to supplemental corroboration.
independent_technical_reasoning: An OS RAID CLI runs only after firmware handoff and can succeed even when the BIOS UI omitted, mislabeled or incompletely enumerated the controller. Conversely, physical installation can alter boot/storage topology before an OS is reachable. Therefore the operator's identity-locked installation and BIOS capture are indispensable and determine MANUAL ONLY classification.
